solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Teacher drops alternative claim

indicators.note: drops means the teacher lets go of a part, so those letters are removed

parts.note: a professor is a university teacher
OR is the word that offers an alternative

explanation.surface: A teacher gives up on another possibility.
explanation.definitionFit: To profess something is to declare or assert it openly, a synonym of claim.

clue.text: Rouse again when a new rake is broken

indicators.note: is broken means the letters are smashed up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A tool gets wrecked and someone is woken a second time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is broken' rearranges A NEW RAKE; 'when' links.
explanation.definitionFit: To reawaken is to waken or stir up once more, so to rouse again.

clue.text: Make urgent list as explained initially of sets of chemical symbols

parts.note: to form is to make

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of each of these words is used

explanation.surface: Someone drafts a priority list of chemistry notations.
explanation.definitionFit: Chemical formulae are combinations of element symbols showing a compound's make-up.

clue.text: Incitement with no time for pretence

indicators.note: with no means the time letter is taken out

parts.note: stimulation is incitement, spurring on

explanation.surface: Encouragement without any delay is a sham.
explanation.definitionFit: A simulation is an imitation or feigning, a form of pretence.

clue.text: Jump cut longways first

parts.note: to axe is to cut

indicators.note: first means just the leading letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: Instructions to cut along the length before anything else.
explanation.definitionFit: An axel is a jump in figure skating with a forward take-off.

clue.text: A gun to remove chewy stuff

indicators.note: remove, read as move again, signals that the letters are moved around

explanation.surface: A weapon used to get rid of something sticky.
explanation.definitionFit: Nougat is a chewy confection of sugar, honey and nuts.

clue.text: Way with pointlessly shrewd law

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way

indicators.note: pointlessly means a compass point, here S for south, is removed

parts.note: astute means shrewd

explanation.surface: A route coupled with cleverness that misses the mark makes legislation.
explanation.walkthrough: Compass points N, S, E and W are crossword letters; 'pointlessly' removes S from ASTUTE to give ATUTE.
explanation.definitionFit: A statute is a written law passed by a legislature.

clue.text: Uninteresting area of court or shipyard

parts.note: dry means dull or uninteresting
the dock is where the accused stands in court

explanation.surface: A boring part of the courtroom, or a place for building ships.
explanation.definitionFit: A dry dock is a drained basin where ships are built or repaired, part of a shipyard.

clue.text: Businessman was hotel employee

parts.note: ex- describes what someone formerly was
a porter carries bags at a hotel

explanation.surface: A trader used to work as staff in a hotel.
explanation.definitionFit: An exporter is a trader who sells goods abroad, so a kind of businessman.

clue.text: One with stuff in Middle East had fringe work

indicators.note: in means the first pieces sit inside the abbreviation for the region

parts.note: one is the indefinite article a
to stuff is to cram

explanation.surface: Someone in the Middle East with material made a decorative edging.
explanation.walkthrough: 'had' is a link; 'One with stuff' looks like a person carrying goods, but it is the article plus a verb for packing tight.
explanation.definitionFit: Macrame is knotted cord craft, often used for fringes and decorative edging.

clue.text: Got down when one fired up

parts.note: one is the indefinite article a
fired up means set alight, lit

explanation.surface: Someone climbed down after a fire was started.
explanation.definitionFit: To alight is to get down from a vehicle or perch, so the past tense means got down.

clue.text: Accolade following a tenor's virtue

indicators.note: following means the accolade comes after the first two pieces

parts.note: T is the abbreviation for tenor
a tribute is an accolade

explanation.surface: Praise follows a singer's good quality.
explanation.definitionFit: An attribute is a quality or characteristic, and a virtue is a good quality.

clue.text: Qualmier, unfortunately, I'm leaving the lady

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests the letters of qualmier are in a bad state, to be rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
the letters I and M are removed from the jumbled pool, as leaving says

explanation.surface: A woman departs because she has stronger misgivings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unfortunately' scrambles QUALMIER and 'leaving' takes out I and M from the pool, leaving a woman's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Raquel is a female first name, so stands for a particular lady.

clue.text: Worker still accepting one that's dust-resistant

indicators.note: accepting means the combined pieces take in another letter

parts.note: an ant is the crossword's classic worker insect
static means still, not moving
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A labourer who stays motionless takes on someone resisting dust.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accepting' slips the Roman numeral for one into the run, between the insect and the word for still; 'that's' links.
explanation.definitionFit: An antistatic material repels the static charge that attracts dust, so it resists dust.

clue.text: Sea song won't be performed in ramshackle area

parts.note: a shanty is a sailors' work song

indicators.note: be performed suggests the letters are worked into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A sailors' song is refused a performance in a run-down neighbourhood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'be performed' rearranges WONT into TOWN; 'in' links.
explanation.definitionFit: A shanty town is a slum of crude makeshift shacks, a ramshackle area.

clue.text: Greek character held by Catherine Jones

definitions.meaning: a letter of the Greek alphabet
the actress Catherine ...-Jones has this word held between her two other names

explanation.surface: A Greek role in a film starring the Welsh actress.
explanation.definitionFit: Zeta is the sixth letter of the Greek alphabet, a character in the written sense.

clue.text: Wipe out bird in select group

indicators.note: in means the bird sits inside the group's word

parts.note: the elite are a select group
mina is a variant spelling of the myna, a starling-like bird

explanation.surface: Destroy a bird belonging to an exclusive club.
explanation.definitionFit: To eliminate is to get rid of completely, a synonym of wipe out.

clue.text: The Spanish fish coming from fictitious place

parts.note: el is Spanish for the
the dorado is a fish, also called mahi-mahi

explanation.surface: A Spanish fish arrives from an imaginary land.
explanation.definitionFit: El Dorado is the legendary city of gold, an imaginary place sought by explorers.

clue.text: Mitchell may be an islander

parts.note: Major Mitchell is a name, as in the explorer Major Thomas Mitchell and the cockatoo named after him
can means may, be allowed to

explanation.surface: A man called Mitchell might come from an island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'be an' links the pieces to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A Majorcan is a native of Majorca, the Spanish Mediterranean island.

clue.text: I am no longer trendy as a result of deadlock

parts.note: I am contracts to I'm
passe means out of fashion

explanation.surface: Someone complains that being unfashionable has left them stuck.
explanation.definitionFit: An impasse is a situation where no progress is possible, a deadlock.

clue.text: Adopt little telepathy on the river

indicators.note: on means in this down clue the first piece sits above the river

parts.note: ESP, extrasensory perception, is the short form for telepathy
the Ouse is an English river

explanation.surface: Take on a bit of mind-reading by the water.
explanation.definitionFit: To espouse a cause is to adopt or embrace it.

clue.text: Behold a new advance

parts.note: lo is an old word for behold

explanation.surface: Look, here is fresh progress.
explanation.definitionFit: An advance of money is a loan, the sum lent ahead of repayment.

clue.text: Bad behaviour when foremost mischief-maker is taking lead

indicators.note: foremost means only the front letter of the word is used

parts.note: to conduct is to lead, as an orchestra

explanation.surface: Misbehaviour happens when the chief troublemaker takes charge.
explanation.definitionFit: Misconduct is improper or wrongful conduct, that is bad behaviour.

clue.text: Unfashionable crowd at the start

parts.note: out means no longer in fashion
a set is a crowd or group of people

explanation.surface: An unstylish group arrives at the beginning.
explanation.definitionFit: The outset is the beginning, the start of something.

clue.text: Reported second person who, say, made call to attract attention

indicators.note: reported means the words are spoken, so their sound gives the entry

parts.note: you is the second-person pronoun, followed by who as written

explanation.surface: Someone, who apparently is next in line, shouted to get noticed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' and 'made' link; spoken, YOU WHO gives the call.
explanation.definitionFit: Yoo-hoo is an informal cry used to attract someone's attention.

clue.text: Checked in development conjuring with a bit over

indicators.note: conjuring, as a magician does, transforms these letters into something new

explanation.surface: A magician's trick with a little extra was checked.
explanation.definitionFit: Something abortive fails to develop, having been stopped before completion.

clue.text: Not having a match in clothing

indicators.note: not having means the letter is removed

parts.note: a vesta is an old type of match

explanation.surface: Someone lacks an equal in dress.
explanation.definitionFit: A vest is a garment, an item of clothing.

clue.text: Ruler performing in a month

indicators.note: in means the performing word sits inside the month

parts.note: March is a month
on means performing, as an actor is on stage

explanation.surface: A ruler appears on stage during one month.
explanation.definitionFit: A monarch is a sovereign, such as a king or queen, who rules.

clue.text: Kind of account for uncertainty

definitions.meaning: a ... account holds entries temporarily in bookkeeping
the anxious state of waiting to know an outcome

explanation.definitionFit: Suspense is the tense uncertainty of waiting for an outcome; a suspense account is a bookkeeping type.

clue.text: Writing about departure in progress

parts.note: a piece of writing about a subject is on it, as in an essay on war
going is departure, as in comings and goings

explanation.surface: A text concerning someone leaving is still being written.
explanation.definitionFit: Something ongoing is continuing and still happening, so in progress.
